prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Connected App configuration and tenant administrator authorization required; Developer Edition sandboxes are free.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Implement Composio OAuth2 integration using free Salesforce Developer Edition orgs to develop and verify Lead/Opportunity toolkits.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Custom rate limit error code (HTTP 420); requires app registration under Podio account settings.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Implement OAuth2 client supporting App-level authentication for automated workspace sync.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Enterprise customer tenant required; user group must have API permissions enabled under Admin > User Management.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Partner with an enterprise capital-markets client or obtain staging credentials to certify the DealCloud data connector.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Admin privileges required in Pylon workspace to create API token; workspace requires paid B2B plan.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Integrate with Pylon API for syncing B2B customer issues across Slack and Teams.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Enterprise contract required; API token creation requires Admin role and API User permission.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build REST wrapper for conversation search and customer profile sync using sandbox instance.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Production messaging requires Meta Business Manager verification, payment method for conversation charges, and pre-approved message templates for outbound initiation.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Develop Cloud API integration using Meta's free developer test numbers before requesting business verification.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: API keys generated from Dashboard > Integrations > API Keys by an admin user on a paid Aircall plan.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build voice log ingestion and call recording transcription fetcher in Composio.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Developer token approval levels (Test Accounts only with test token; Basic/Standard Access requires application review by Google Ads API compliance team).
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Develop tool against Google Ads test manager accounts while submitting compliance questionnaire for Basic Access.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: App Review required for `ads_management` and `ads_read` permissions to manage third-party ad accounts; Development mode limited to admins.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build Composio Meta Ads reporting connector in Development Mode while prepping App Review submission screencast.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Production API access requires Pinterest app review approval; Trial access is limited to developer test accounts.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build Pin publishing and board management tool using Trial sandbox access while submitting app for standard access.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: App Review required for `threads_content_publish` and `threads_basic` for public users; dev accounts work immediately for developer's own account.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Deploy personal publisher tool on developer mode, then apply for Meta App Review.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Commerce API requires Squarespace Commerce plan (Commerce Advanced or Basic depending on endpoint).
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build Squarespace order syncing and inventory adjustment tools for paid store owners.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Requires creator/seller account setup to obtain API keys from seller portal.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build Composio checkout session generator tool using FanBasis/Commas public API.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: API access requires an active paid subscription with API package add-on.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build keyword ranking and site audit fetcher tool in Composio.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Requires active Brex corporate account; admin must generate API user token in developer portal.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build expense report ingestion and card limit adjustment actions in Composio.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Requires business Ramp account; developer application registration requires business administrator permission.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build corporate expense audit and receipt matching tools using Ramp Developer API.

prerequisites_required.main_blocker: Requires active Devin seat/subscription to generate `cog_` token from developer settings.
prerequisites_required.recommended_next_step: Build Composio session delegator: spawn a Devin task from another AI agent and await completion webhook.

outreach_required.main_blocker: Advertising API requires formal Marketing Developer Platform (MDP) application approval; Development tier is strictly sandbox-restricted.
outreach_required.recommended_next_step: Submit Composio application to LinkedIn Marketing Developer Platform for Community Management / Ads Reporting partnership.

outreach_required.main_blocker: Requires Salesforce Commerce Cloud instance with Account Manager client ID, SLAS tenant configuration, and short-code routing.
outreach_required.recommended_next_step: Obtain staging credentials or partner sandbox from an enterprise SFCC client before implementing shopper/admin workflows.

outreach_required.main_blocker: Developer registration profile review, professional seller account requirement, and strict data protection policy (DPP) audits for PII-restricted roles.
outreach_required.recommended_next_step: Submit developer registration profile and utilize SP-API sandbox environment with test endpoints for development.

outreach_required.main_blocker: Contract required with Japanese entity; requires client certificate provisioning and merchant setup.
outreach_required.recommended_next_step: Engage Paygent sales/technical support for developer staging certificates and Japanese documentation translation.

outreach_required.main_blocker: Enterprise contract add-on required alongside PitchBook platform subscription; credit consumption model returns HTTP 402 when depleted.
outreach_required.recommended_next_step: Engage PitchBook Direct Data team to explore partnership licensing or client staging key.

outreach_required.main_blocker: Public consumer NotebookLM has no developer API; programmatic API is gated under NotebookLM Enterprise via Google Cloud licensing.
outreach_required.recommended_next_step: Target Google Cloud NotebookLM Enterprise API using GCP project credentials or build a local RAG alternative using Gemini API.
